title: PCSX2 1.4.0 advances PS2 preservation
summary: In 2016, PCSX2 1.4.0 became a notable emulation milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2016, PCSX2 1.4.0 became a notable emulation milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
This emulator milestone supports long-term preservation, compatibility research and access to legally owned PS2 software.
